title: Schedule the unreduced semantic oracle in the guarded warm-audit lane
detail: The private CaptureExtension oracle port contributes unreduced physical/logical pressure and five-minute due time to the existing warm-audit scheduler. The same native queue first completes rolling ciphertext work, then runs the independent full semantic oracle under the real maintenance-task brand and original native/current, suspension, shadow and comparison guards. Foreground observation reads the existing token set, and queued foreground work interrupts the discretionary attempt. Physical256/five-minute due and physical/logical1,024 hard-attempt ceilings stay. Owners without this scheduler retain synchronous full-oracle behavior; explicit audit-every remains immediate. Reduced owners use their existing independent oracle and an inactive unreduced port cannot spin its timer. Close clears the port and counts. No new lane or effect permission.

The read-only reviewer initially searched for a string label as an identifier; corrected selector preserves the failed reviewer and proves the complete reference verifier and comparison/refusal/erasure bodies AST-exact except completed-oracle clock/count reset. Native run/settlement and old policy AST remain exact. decisionTitle: Keep unreduced full-oracle work in the existing warm-audit lane
decision: Use one private scheduler port and the real maintenance-task brand, observing the existing foreground token set. Keep independent full comparison, all guards and a fallback for owners without this scheduler. A hard cap forces an attempt only; interruption still wins. Reduced and unreduced oracle lifetimes remain separate.
next: Harden G8 with actual four-position reads, B bounded aggregation and shared cache/tail/wire reservations, preserving native chain order, round robin and send yielding. Then real composed peer/Worker floor lifecycle, aged interior cold and same-tree writer-off rollback image. Continue automatically after each freeze.
